scope: Shipped public CLI device, refresh, revocation and sign-in resource exchange; does not claim current generated inventory parity.
approval: Hosted same-origin POST requires live session, user_code and explicit decision; SDK never approves automatically.
token: POST /{slug}/oauth/token; public client_id, no secret or Authorization header
refresh: refresh_token grant rotates atomically; uncertain outcomes must never replay the old token
exchange: urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange; live subject_token, access_token subject type, organization required; project/scope optional; presenter and current role rechecked; no database restriction
revoke: POST /{slug}/oauth/revoke; client_id + token, no secret; 200 for unknown/revoked tokens too
errors: 400 OAuth errors, 401 invalid client, 429 rate_limited/Retry-After, 503 unavailable; preserve typed result; no retry
lifetime: User grant 5 minutes, resource exchange 60 seconds, refresh 14 days; refresh does not renew original authentication/MFA
qualification: HTTP fixtures only until exact-source live proof; no producer binaries or fake success promoted to live
public_authorization_code: Registered public applications only; original redirect_uri and PKCE code_verifier required; never invent a CLI code grant/callback
